test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

Sara was bringing the cake for the party.

options.text: The cake for the party was being bought by Sara.
The cake for the party is being brought by Sara.
The cake for the party was being brought by Sara.
The cake for the party were being brought by Sara.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**The cake for the party was being brought by Sara.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence is in the past continuous tense.
 
• To convert it into passive voice, we need to use the auxiliary verb "**was being**" followed by the past participle form of the main verb "brought</strong&g
